## Trigger Conditions

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Check the stream cancelable flag before calling cancel_stream; non-cancelable streams run until their duration ends.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_cancel_stream(&f.recipient, &id));
```
